environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS Application Load Balancer with a custom listener rule chain. The ALB target group has a deregistration delay of 300s. An AWS WAF WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/session-protect/abc123) is attached with a rate-based rule (RateBasedStatement) configured with a 100-request-per-5-minute aggregate key on the forwarded X-Session-Token header value. The rule action is BLOCK returning 429. Additionally, a second rule uses a regex pattern set matching the /logout followed by /profile or /update sequence within the same source IP, with a 10-second evaluation window via AWS WAF ATP (Account Takeover Prevention) managed rule group in COUNT mode feeding a label-based BLOCK rule. The ALB also enforces connection draining with idle timeout of 5 seconds, meaning rapid reconnection attempts from the same source get TCP RST after the rate threshold.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF WebACL attached

waf_rules.name: LogoutReplaySequenceDetection
waf_rules.description: Detects logout-then-access pattern within 10s window per source IP using ATP labels

config.network: ALB in public subnet, application in private subnet
config.security_group: sg-private: inbound only from ALB security group
